meta.description: Makes points around one spot, each turned from the one before by the golden angle, where branch_from_points grows a clump of stems or instance_from_points places a rosette of leaves. The points sit on no path.

origin.description: Where the first point sits. Read for every point, alpha is where it sits in the spiral.

points.description: Centres, for example the points of sample_mesh on a substrate. Every centre gets a spiral of its own, around the direction of the centre instead of straight up from the origin.

amount.description: How many points a spiral has.

height.description: How far the last point sits above the first, the points in between rise evenly. 0 puts all of them on one spot. Read for every point.

rotation.description: How far every point turns from the one before it, in radians: 2.3998 rad is the golden angle, 3.1416 rad puts them in two ranks. Read for every point.
